name: Group Policy registry value
packageArguments: Required: {"Gpo":"<GUID or display name of an existing GPO>","Key":"HKLM\\Software\\Policies\\<vendor>\\<product>","ValueName":"<name>"}. Plan-only unless "Mode":"Apply" (with "Value"; "Type" DWord, the default, or String) or "Mode":"Rollback" (removes the value). Key must be under HKLM or HKCU Software\\Policies or Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies. Apply and Rollback run Backup-GPO to %ProgramData%\\Relian\\gpo-backups\\{GPO GUID} first and read the value back; an unchanged value is left alone without a backup. Never creates, links or deletes a GPO, or changes its permissions. Run where the GroupPolicy module is installed; writes go to the PDC emulator. Uninstall only plans.
